body.label: Target
body.html: Self and one willing ally within 4 units, or self alone.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Share simple combat warnings until the start of your next turn. Each target ignores the next ordinary distraction penalty affecting a Combat Card during that time.

surges.html: One target may move 1 unit toward the other; alone, you may move 1 unit.
Each target gains +1 Composure until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Projection
rider.html: If you accepted Strain, the first time a linked target is missed before your next turn, it may move 1 unit without triggering that attacker's movement Reactions.
